div.head: Af El. 13
div.ab: Se mon se ðe his gewealdes monnan ofslea, swelte se deaðe. Se ðe hine þonne nedes ofsloge oððe unwillum oððe ungewealdes, swelce hine God swa sende on his honda, ⁊ he hine ne ymbsyrede, sie he feores wyrðe ⁊ folcryhtre bote, gif he friðstowe gesece. Gif hwa ðonne of giernesse ⁊ gewealdes ofslea his þone nehstan þurh searwa, aluc ðu hine from minum weofode, to þam þæt he deaðe swelte.

The man who intentionally slays someone – let him die the death. However, he who slew him out of necessity or unwillingly or accidentally, as God sent to his hands, and he did not lie in wait [for his victim]: let him be worthy of life and of the remedy permitted by folk-law, if he should seek a place of refuge. But if someone with deliberation and intent slays his neighbor through guile, take him away from my altar, that he may die the death.

Se man þe hys gewealdes man ofslea, swelte se deaþe. Se þe hine þonne neades ofslea oððe ungewylles oððe ungewealdes, swylce hyne God sende swa on his handa, 7 he him ne syrwde ymbe, sy he feores wyrþe 7 folcrihtere bote, gif he friðstowe gesece. Gyf hwa þonne of geornnesse 7 gewealdes ofslea hys þone nyhstan purh syrwunge, alúc þu hyne fram minum weofode, to ðam þæt he deaþe swelte.
